ideas.title: Rained off? Clear the admin before the brew goes cold
ideas.why: 'Rained off' was the most common UK site chatter this window (CobbettBill88, manfuego007, Fix Radio weather clip).
ideas.build: 5-8s of real rain on Dene's own van windscreen (no face needed), then real app screens: 02-enquiries -> 03a-quotes -> 05b-invoice-paid. Captions in UK English. End card: Less admin. More trade.

ideas.title: Customer texts Part 2: the quote chase
ideas.why: Repeats our best format (chat bubbles, no people, clearly British). Customer-side trade posts (MenAtWork_MC) show the customer relationship is relatable.
ideas.build: Chat-bubble Reel using only real texts: Dene's own or follower-submitted screenshots, anonymised with permission. No invented lines. Resolve on the real 03c-customer-quote-accepted screen.

ideas.title: Budget day: what changed for your van
ideas.why: Martin Lewis's pre-Budget mileage post hit 238K views and 303 likes, the biggest trade-relevant post in the window. Budget is Wed 28 Oct; MTD quarterly deadline is 7 Nov.
ideas.build: Post after the Budget, using only confirmed figures with a source on screen. Text cards on navy/orange, then real 01b-home-money screen with 'know what you've earned'. Never claim a mileage or tax feature the app doesn't have.
